description:
The RNWMP Trail runs adjacent to the Cypress Creek (motorized) Trail. The RNWMP trail has significant provincial and First Nations cultural values.

This trail is non-motorized access. The trail can be wet as it traverses through muskeg areas.
directions: From Fort St John drive north on the Alaska Hwy for 158 km to Pink Mountain. Turn onto the Cypress Creek Road and drive another 40 km. Turn West up to the Cypress Creek Cemetery and keep past to the Airstrip. The trailhead is 3 km passed the airstrip. Trail users stage from the airstrip mainly.
title: North West Mounted Police Trail
